claims.text: The proposed model performs similarly to the baseline implementation of BIBREF17 in the recipe retrieval task.
The model significantly reduces training time compared to baseline methods, allowing for more efficient cross-modal retrieval.
The model's ingredient attention mechanism improves retrieval accuracy compared to baseline implementations, which exhibit a broad range of accuracy.
